findings.risk: The custody argument adds an unstated permission invariant: every generated directory remains R-owned 0700 and non-R/non-GATE references allow no future mutation. Ownership, ordinary chmod and ACL actions in the same design do not enforce it.
findings.disposition: Required W1-CUSTODY-CLOSURE; preserve original accepted cases rather than banning an original action to make the argument pass.

findings.risk: Serialized API dispatch is weaker than completion of all buffered/deferred work. The promised mask set also needs to match its inventory-generation rule.
findings.disposition: Required W1-CUSTODY-CLOSURE; retain all stated installed premises and UNKNOWN behavior.

findings.risk: An implementation could choose one side of conflicting protocol/journal/setup/image rules, creating undocumented exceptions or lost custody/failed-record evidence.
findings.disposition: Repair exact frozen specification and independently re-review; operator choice in principle authorizes no exception.
